prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1051; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear impact sustained while turning left in a motor vehicle. The reported mechanism is consistent with the low back strain diagnosed, and the force described fits the pattern of soft tissue injury observed on examination. Imaging and physical findings clearly support the diagnosis. Care totaled 30 visits, including manual therapy, stretching and strengthening exercises, and graded activity guidance. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms and range of motion improved. The patient was also treated for low back complaints within the past two years, and that earlier condition appears to contribute to some of the current symptoms. Billing records reflect one charge per service, with no duplicate entries. At the time of discharge, the patient had reached a stable functional level and was released to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms worsen.
